The fill-in side of the catalog — worksheets, forms, records and step-by-step beginner guides, grouped by the job they do. Same products as Downloads, same instant checkout.

✏️ TEMPLATES, EXPLAINED PLAIN

What is a template? The hard part is already done.

A template is a ready-made page where the work is already done for you — the boxes are drawn, the design is finished, the math is built in. You just put in your own numbers and words.

🧮 THE ONES THAT CALCULATE

Spreadsheets like Excel — think of them as an incredibly advanced calculator. You type in your numbers and they add everything up by themselves: totals, balances, how much you still owe, miles driven. A calculator that never forgets and never makes a mistake.

✏️ THE ONES YOU FILL IN

Worksheets and forms with the boxes and lines already drawn. You write your answers in, check things off as you go, and print a fresh copy whenever you need one.

🎨 THE ONES YOU MAKE YOUR OWN

Invitations, menus, flyers and cards with the design already done. You change the name, the date and the words to yours — then print them or post them. A free Canva account is all you need.

💡 WHAT YOU'RE PAYING FOR: the hours of work already done — the formulas, the design, the layout — so you never start from a blank page. And these give something back: answers, totals and a plan, not just paper.

About the shop

Built by a working driver, for everyday life

Christopher DeWitt is a delivery driver and trainer in South Florida. The shop started with the guides he wished new drivers had — then grew into planners and trackers for budgets, gardens, boats, classrooms, holidays and everything in between. He doesn't run it alone: Frankie, his AI assistant, builds the products, keeps the store stocked and organized, and handles the day-to-day — Chris & Frankie, at your service.

Not everything here is a printable. The shop has three kinds of downloads: print-and-use PDFs (real checklists, logs and worksheets), editable Microsoft files — real Excel spreadsheets you download and open on your phone or computer, with working formulas and charts that do the math for you: type in your own numbers and the budgets, debt payoffs and totals calculate themselves — plus Word and PowerPoint templates you fill in and make your own — and done-for-you services, where the work is done for you and delivered by email. Everything is in plain language, in English and Spanish. No fluff, no hype, no advice dressed up as something it's not — money and health titles are organizers and trackers, clearly labeled.

Meet the partner: Frankie is Chris's AI assistant — an AI partner with blue highlights who does the homework behind the shop. She researches what people actually need, builds and checks every file, writes the listings in English and Spanish, and keeps the shop, the storefronts and the numbers lined up. Chris brings the real-world experience — six years delivering and training drivers in South Florida — and makes the final calls. Frankie brings the research, the building and the follow-through. Two halves of one shop.

See everything in the shop ↗ for Chris's picks, videos and all store links in one place.

Good to know

Quick answers

How do I get my file after I pay?

Your download link is emailed to you immediately after checkout, to the email you used at checkout. Check spam/promotions if it doesn't show in a few minutes, then email dewitt3089@hotmail.com and we'll sort it.

What format are the products?

It depends on the product — the product page shows the format before you buy. Most downloads are PDFs sized for US Letter: they open on any phone, tablet or computer, and you can print pages as many times as you need. Spreadsheets and templates are Excel, Word, or PowerPoint files you can edit and calculate in — they open in Microsoft 365 or free apps like Google Sheets/Docs/Slides or LibreOffice.

Can I buy everything in one place?

Yes — every Get it now button here takes you straight to checkout for that exact product, and your download is emailed to you right after you pay.

Something's wrong with my order — who do I contact?

Email dewitt3089@hotmail.com, message on Instagram or Facebook. Tell us the product name and the email from checkout and we'll make it right.

What's the refund policy?

We don't offer refunds on digital downloads — all sales are final, because a downloaded file can't be returned. But if there's a genuine problem, we'll make it right: we'll fix it or replace it with another download of your choice — any download in the shop, no price limit. See the full policy below.

Our promise

No-refund & replacement policy

Instant delivery on every download — and if something's wrong, we fix it or replace it with any download of your choice.

Digital downloads can't be returned once they're delivered, so all sales are final and we don't offer refunds. If something goes wrong, reach out and we will do everything we can to make it right — re-sending your file, fixing access, or replacing the product. Here's exactly how it works:

🚫 No refunds on downloads

Because a downloaded file can't be sent back, purchases can't be refunded — please check the product details before you buy. If you have any question about a product, email dewitt3089@hotmail.com first and we'll help you pick the right one.

🔄 Replacements instead

If there's a genuine problem — the file won't open, the link breaks, or you received the wrong file — we'll fix it or replace it with another download of your choice — any download in the shop, at any price.

🤝 We make it right first

Most problems are simple — a missing email, a file that won't open, the wrong product. Message us and we'll fix it, re-send it, or swap it.
